MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is it important to say tones correctly in Mandarin? (1 mark)
   A. Because tones are only for songs
   B. Because the tone can change the meaning of a word
   C. Because tones make the word longer
   D. Because tones are only used in writing

2. What is a good strategy to speak Chinese clearly? (1 mark)
   A. Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
   B. Speak as fast as possible
   C. Whisper all the time
   D. Ignore the tones

3. Which Kiswahili word is like Mandarin 妈妈 māma? (1 mark)
   A. mama
   B. shule
   C. dada
   D. kaka

4. Which Chinese word means "daughter"? (1 mark)
   A. 哥哥 gēge
   B. 女儿 nǚ'ér
   C. 是 shì
   D. 有 yǒu

5. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom."? (1 mark)
   A. 门在左边。
   B. 电视在桌子上。
   C. 床在卧室。
   D. 电视在客厅。

6. In the Chinese week, which day is 星期一? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Monday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Sunday

7. What does 祝你生日快乐 mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is your birthday
   B. Thank you for the cake
   C. See you tomorrow
   D. Happy birthday to you

8. Which Chinese word means "flat bread"? (1 mark)
   A. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   B. 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   C. 饼 bǐng
   D. 水 shuǐ

9. What does 水果 (shuǐguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. What
   B. Drinks
   C. Fruit (as a group)
   D. Milk

10. What does 这是什么? ask? (1 mark)
   A. When is it?
   B. Where is it?
   C. What is this?
   D. Who is this?

11. What does 哭 (kū) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To laugh, to smile
   B. To wash hands
   C. Hand
   D. To cry

12. What does 浴室 (yùshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sofa
   B. Below
   C. Bathroom
   D. Where

13. In the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马, what does 骂 mà mean? (1 mark)
   A. To scold
   B. Mother
   C. To ride
   D. Slow

14. What does 早上好 zǎoshang hǎo mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Good night
   C. Good morning
   D. Thank you

15. A picture shows a father, but the label says 妈妈. Is the pair right or wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Right, 错
   B. Wrong, 错
   C. Right, 对
   D. Wrong, 对

16. What does 儿子 (érzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Son
   B. Older brother
   C. Home, family
   D. Is, am, are

17. What does 东西 (dōngxi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Toilet
   B. Door
   C. Things
   D. Sofa

18. Which sentence means "Where is the television?"? (1 mark)
   A. 床在卧室。
   B. 电视在哪儿?
   C. 沙发在门旁边。
   D. 卧室里有床。

19. What does 清真寺 (qīngzhēnsì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Week (short form)
   B. Mosque
   C. Church
   D. Today

20. What does 周 (zhōu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. School
   B. To rest
   C. Tomorrow
   D. Week (short form)

21. Fill the blank: 我____吃香蕉。 (I like to eat bananas.) (1 mark)
   A. 喜欢
   B. 在
   C. 不是
   D. 有

22. What does 米饭 (mǐfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Banana
   B. Cooked rice
   C. Fruit (as a group)
   D. Mango

23. What is scanning? (1 mark)
   A. Drawing a picture
   B. Singing a song
   C. Reading slowly word by word
   D. Looking for one particular word or fact

24. What does 太阳 (tàiyáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Not
   B. Sun
   C. Drought
   D. Weather

25. How long is the pause at a full stop compared with a comma? (1 mark)
   A. The same
   B. There is no pause
   C. Shorter
   D. Longer

26. What does 雨 (yǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Rain
   B. Small
   C. Very
   D. Snow

27. Read the pinyin: shāfā zài mén pángbiān. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The television is on the table.
   B. The sofa is beside the door.
   C. The bed is in the bedroom.
   D. Where is the television?

28. What does 左边 (zuǒbian) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Sofa
   C. Left side
   D. Living room

29. On which vowel does the tone mark go in nǐ? (1 mark)
   A. u
   B. No vowel
   C. i
   D. n

30. Which sentence means "This is my mother."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我妈妈。
   B. 我爱你。
   C. 这是我爸爸。
   D. 这是我姐姐。

31. Which tone mark is written in bàba? (1 mark)
   A. One mark, on the first a
   B. A mark on the last a
   C. Two marks
   D. No marks

32. Which order does a sentence about the week use? (1 mark)
   A. who + when + what
   B. what + when + who
   C. what + who + when
   D. when + what + who

33. What does 二 (èr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eight
   B. One
   C. Two
   D. Five

34. What is a 田字格 used for? (1 mark)
   A. Drawing maps
   B. Writing characters neatly in a square with cross lines
   C. Cutting paper
   D. Counting money

35. What does 菠菜 (bōcài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Dinner
   B. Mango
   C. Spinach
   D. Apple

36. Which sentence is correctly punctuated? (1 mark)
   A. 我吃米饭? 你呢。
   B. 我吃米饭、你呢、
   C. 我吃米饭!你呢。
   D. 我吃米饭。你呢?

37. Which character means "mouth" and has 3 strokes? (1 mark)
   A. 手
   B. 头
   C. 耳
   D. 口

38. Fill the blank: 今天有____。 (Today there is sun.) (1 mark)
   A. 云
   B. 太阳
   C. 雨
   D. 雪

39. What does 沙发 (shāfā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Chair
   C. Under
   D. Sofa

40. Which word is pronounced shàngmiàn? (1 mark)
   A. 上面
   B. 沙发
   C. 冰箱
   D. 放

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The rain is heavy." (2 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" (2 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水, 没有 and 门. (3 marks)

44. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天气 and 星期六. (2 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期二 and 晚饭. (2 marks)

46. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "And you?" (2 marks)

47. Write the first two strokes of 右 and the first two strokes of 左. (3 marks)

48. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 说 and 再见. (2 marks)

49. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肩膀, 切 and 去. (3 marks)

50. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "When is your birthday?" (3 marks)

51. Give three things to do when planning a showcase item. (3 marks)

52. Name the three parts of a Mandarin syllable. (2 marks)

53. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" and "Hello! (polite)" (4 marks)

54. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 儿子 and 浴室. (2 marks)

55. Give three tips for reading aloud clearly in Mandarin. (3 marks)

56. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The chair is under the table." (3 marks)

57. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." and "The bathroom is beside the garden." (4 marks)

58. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水果 and 蔬菜. (2 marks)

59. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The weather is very good today." (3 marks)

60. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 风 and 鸡肉. (2 marks)

61. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 听 and 雨. (2 marks)

62. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I have two eyes." (3 marks)

63. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 上面, 周 and 同学们. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Because the tone can change the meaning of a word
   A different tone can mean a different word, such as mā and mǎ.

2. A — Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
   Listening and copying the tone shapes helps you speak clearly.

3. A — mama
   Mama means mother in both languages.

4. B — 女儿 nǚ'ér
   女儿 (nǚ'ér) means daughter.

5. C — 床在卧室。
   床在卧室。 (chuáng zài wòshì.) means "The bed is in the bedroom.".

6. B — Monday
   Chinese counts the days from Monday.

7. D — Happy birthday to you
   祝 is to wish, and 生日快乐 is happy birthday.

8. C — 饼 bǐng
   饼 (bǐng) means flat bread.

9. C — Fruit (as a group)
   水果 (shuǐguǒ) means fruit (as a group).

10. C — What is this?
   什么 means what.

11. D — To cry
   哭 (kū) means to cry.

12. C — Bathroom
   浴室 (yùshì) means bathroom.

13. A — To scold
   骂 is to scold.

14. C — Good morning
   早上 is morning and 好 is good.

15. B — Wrong, 错
   妈妈 is mother, not father.

16. A — Son
   儿子 (érzi) means son.

17. C — Things
   东西 (dōngxi) means things.

18. B — 电视在哪儿?
   电视在哪儿? (diànshì zài nǎr?) means "Where is the television?".

19. B — Mosque
   清真寺 (qīngzhēnsì) means mosque.

20. D — Week (short form)
   周 (zhōu) means week (short form).

21. A — 喜欢
   喜欢 means to like.

22. B — Cooked rice
   米饭 (mǐfàn) means cooked rice.

23. D — Looking for one particular word or fact
   Scanning finds a specific detail.

24. B — Sun
   太阳 (tàiyáng) means sun.

25. D — Longer
   A full stop needs a longer pause.

26. A — Rain
   雨 (yǔ) means rain.

27. B — The sofa is beside the door.
   shāfā zài mén pángbiān. is 沙发在门旁边。, which means "The sofa is beside the door.".

28. C — Left side
   左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

29. C — i
   The only vowel is i, and the mark replaces its dot.

30. A — 这是我妈妈。
   这是我妈妈。 (zhè shì wǒ māma.) means "This is my mother.".

31. A — One mark, on the first a
   The second syllable is light, so it has no mark.

32. A — who + when + what
   我 + 星期三 + 去学校.

33. C — Two
   二 (èr) means two.

34. B — Writing characters neatly in a square with cross lines
   It keeps characters even and centred.

35. C — Spinach
   菠菜 (bōcài) means spinach.

36. D — 我吃米饭。你呢?
   A statement ends with 。 and a question with ?.

37. D — 口
   口 kǒu.

38. B — 太阳
   太阳 is the sun.

39. D — Sofa
   沙发 (shāfā) means sofa.

40. A — 上面
   上面 is pronounced shàngmiàn and means above.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 雨很大。 yǔ hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 水: shuǐ, water. 没有: méiyǒu, there is not. 门: mén, door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天气: tiānqì, weather. 星期六: xīngqīliù, Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期二: xīngqī'èr, Tuesday. 晚饭: wǎnfàn, dinner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你呢? nǐ ne?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: 右: 撇 then 横. 左: 横 then 撇.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct stroke pair and 1 mark for the difference.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: 说: shuō, to speak. 再见: zàijiàn, goodbye.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肩膀: jiānbǎng, shoulder. 切: qiē, to cut. 去: qù, to go.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose an item, decide who does what, list the materials and words needed, practise several times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: An initial, a final and a tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two parts and 1 mark for all three.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo! 您好! nín hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 儿子: érzi, son. 浴室: yùshì, bathroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the whole line first; find the tones; read slowly and clearly; pause at punctuation; speak loudly enough for everyone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: 椅子在桌子下。 yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān. 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: 水果: shuǐguǒ, fruit (as a group). 蔬菜: shūcài, vegetables.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: 今天天气很好。 jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风: fēng, wind. 鸡肉: jīròu, chicken (meat).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: 听: tīng, to listen, to hear. 雨: yǔ, rain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我有两只眼睛。 wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

63. (3 marks)
   Answer: 上面: shàngmiàn, above. 周: zhōu, week (short form). 同学们: tóngxuémen, classmates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
